newsitem.title: NORWAY: NORDIC SKIING-NORWAY STAY IN FRONT TO TAKE TEAM GOLD.
newsitem.headline: NORDIC SKIING-NORWAY STAY IN FRONT TO TAKE TEAM GOLD.

text.p: Norway scored an impressive win in the combined team event at the Nordic skiing world championships on Wednesday.
Helped by two brilliant jumps by Bjarte Engen Vik, the Norwegians started the 4x5-km relay in front and increased their lead.
Fred Boerre Lundberg, who completed the last lap for them, crossed the line with the clock on 52 minutes 18 seconds, according to provisional results.
Finland were second 45.6 seconds behind and Austria came third a further 27.5 seconds back.
World and Olympic champions Japan, who were sixth after the ski jumping, dropped even further back in the cross-country relay to end a disappointing ninth.
